purpose: Same-model-mesh ablation requested in peer review (isolates mesh-architecture / ensembling effect from model-heterogeneity effect)
finding: Homogeneous 5-agent mesh (all competence=0.74, i.e. simulating five copies of ONE model) achieves accuracy=0.975, statistically indistinguishable from the heterogeneous 5-agent mesh's reported 0.975. This indicates the reported accuracy lift is attributable to 5-way ensembling of independent scorers, not to model heterogeneity, under the MockLLM scoring model used for all currently committed results.
